tv.changelog: Install Stremio stream and catalog add-ons. Enable or disable them individually or in groups. The source picker combines results from enabled add-ons and shows the provider, language, quality, file size, and seed count. Browse movies and series in TR TV&Mov. Pick an episode or movie to open its source list. Watch official trailers on YouTube and use automatic dual subtitles when matching tracks are available and dual subtitles are enabled. TV Live opens with Iraq by default. Search for a country by name or first letter. Favorite countries appear near the top of the picker. Favorite channels appear first in the channel list. Refresh the Iraqi Nexonic playlist automatically or on demand. Open IPTV separately from TV Live. Add M3U and M3U8 playlists or Xtream Codes. Enable the Arabic and open channel lists in settings. The app caches channel logos and keeps channel favorites. Choose a preferred audio language in Settings. The player selects a matching track when it is available. The torrent player prioritizes the first pieces and the media index before playback. Press Back during a live channel to return to the channel list. Add-on settings use larger cards and show the active count and per-provider status. You can exclude add-on streams from Continue Watching. Open the source code and third-party licenses from Settings. Help and support links open the Local Cinema site.

phone.changelog: Add Stremio stream and catalog add-ons from TV Hub or open a stremio:// install link. Expand or collapse External Add-ons in Connection. Changes to add-ons sync to the paired TV. Use the floating TV remote across tabs and during live channels. Swipe down on its header to close the remote panel. Movie posters and music covers are larger. Use music settings to show or hide track information on the TV and set how long it stays visible. Open RSS from the browser toolbar and Download Center from the Downloader tab. Use Sync Now in TV Hub to send supported settings and channel favorites. Fixed a GeckoView startup crash in the optimized release build. About shows the Local Cinema Manager logo and credits MEEDX. It describes LibreTorrent as part of Download Center. It also links to the source code and third-party licenses.
